title: Bonus Episode: The College Admissions Scandal and the Psychology of Affluence

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a podcast from the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听美国心理学会出品的播客《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢纳。

sentences.en: Today, we're doing a bonus episode related to the college admissions bribery scandal that was exposed this week.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们制作了一期特别节目，内容与本周曝光的大学招生贿赂丑闻有关。

sentences.en: This is the case in which prosecutors accused affluent parents of paying a consultant to get their children into prestigious universities
sentences.zh: 在该案件中，检察官指控富裕的家长花钱雇佣顾问，通过让别人代考SAT或伪造体育成就，

sentences.en: by having someone else take their SATs or by fabricating athletic achievements.
sentences.zh: 将他们的孩子送入名牌大学。

sentences.en: Our guest for this episode is Dr. Sunia Luther, Foundation Professor of Psychology at Arizona
sentences.zh: 我们本期的嘉宾是亚利桑那州立大学的心理学基金会教授苏妮亚·卢瑟博士。

sentences.en: State University.
sentences.zh: 州立大学。

sentences.en: She specializes in adolescent development, vulnerability, and resilience in young people in poverty, as well as teens from upper middle class families.
sentences.zh: 她专门研究青少年发展，以及贫困青少年和中上层家庭青少年的脆弱性与韧性。

sentences.en: Dr. Luther was also featured in a 2014 episode of Speaking of Psychology called The Mental Price of Affluence.
sentences.zh: 卢瑟博士也曾出现在2014年《心理学谈话》的一期节目中，主题是《富裕带来的心理代价》。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us today, Dr. Luther.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天参加我们的节目，卢瑟博士。

sentences.en: It's great to have you back on the show.
sentences.zh: 很高兴您能再次做客。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So developing an identity and learning autonomy are crucial parts of growing up.
sentences.zh: 那么，培养自我认同和学习自主性是成长过程中至关重要的部分。

sentences.en: And of course, parents can help their teens navigate the college application process, but teens really should have some level of control over it.
sentences.zh: 当然，家长可以帮助孩子应对大学申请流程，但孩子确实应该对此拥有一定程度的掌控权。

sentences.en: So if a parent is basically doing everything to get their kid into a college, how does that affect their teen's self-esteem?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果家长几乎包办了一切来让孩子进入大学，这会如何影响青少年的自尊心呢？

sentences.en: Well, yes, I agree with you that adolescence is a time when kids should be developing a sense of autonomy, their own identity, and so on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我同意你的观点，青春期是孩子们应该培养自主意识、自我认同感等的时期。

sentences.en: And in this current generation of youngsters, that is not the case for many of them who are aiming to get into the better colleges and schools.
sentences.zh: 而在当今这一代年轻人中，许多以进入更好大学和学校为目标的孩子并非如此。

sentences.en: Having said that, I don't believe it's fair to put the blame squarely on the parents.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我认为将责任完全归咎于家长是不公平的。

sentences.en: Why do I say that?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么说呢？

sentences.en: Because this pressure to get ahead doesn't come only from parents.
sentences.zh: 因为这种出人头地的压力不仅仅来自家长。

sentences.en: People ask me, Professor Luther, where does this pressure come from?
sentences.zh: 人们问我：“卢瑟教授，这种压力从何而来？”

sentences.en: And my answer typically is, where does it not come from?
sentences.zh: 我的回答通常是：“它从哪里不来呢？”

sentences.en: It comes from parents.
sentences.zh: 它来自家长。

sentences.en: It comes from teachers and coaches who want their kids to be, you know, on state levels and have all these accolades.
sentences.zh: 它来自那些希望孩子在州级比赛中获奖并获得各种荣誉的老师和教练。

sentences.en: It comes from peers.
sentences.zh: 它来自同龄人。

sentences.en: They compare notes with each other constantly, and it comes from kids themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不断地互相攀比，它也来自孩子们自己。

sentences.en: So while I agree with you that young people, adolescents these days, in this demographic particularly, don't have that
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我同意你的观点，即当今的年轻人，特别是这一人口统计学群体中的青少年，没有那种

sentences.en: who am I, the choice to say who am I, explore that sense of identity.
sentences.zh: “我是谁”的选择权，无法去说“我是谁”，去探索那种认同感。

sentences.en: I don't believe it's the fault of the parents.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这并不是家长的错。

sentences.en: I believe it's the fault of a system that is basically corralling the kids as a herd toward
sentences.zh: 我认为这是整个系统的错，它基本上像赶牛群一样把孩子们赶向

sentences.en: do everything you possibly can academically and in terms of extracurriculars, and that is your job.
sentences.zh: “在学术和课外活动方面尽你所能”，这就是你的工作。

sentences.en: That is who you are for all these years.
sentences.zh: 这就是你多年来所代表的一切。

sentences.en: And what is that doing to the mental health of our teens today, children and teens?
sentences.zh: 那么，这对当今青少年、儿童和青少年的心理健康造成了什么影响？

sentences.en: The toll this extracts on them is enormous.
sentences.zh: 这对他们造成的代价是巨大的。

sentences.en: You know, people often speak about, some people do, about teenagers today being overprotected and mollycoddled and such.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们经常谈论，有些人会说，当今的青少年被过度保护、娇生惯养等等。

sentences.en: Truthfully, my own take on this is that they're horrendously overworked, horrendously overworked.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我对此的看法是，他们被极其沉重地压榨了，极其沉重地压榨了。

sentences.en: You know, we read about the lack of sleep and so on, the rates of depression, self-harm, tragically suicide,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们读到关于睡眠不足等等的消息，抑郁、自残，悲剧性地自杀的比例，

sentences.en: substance abuse.
sentences.zh: 还有药物滥用。

sentences.en: Our kids are under such enormous pressure and strain.
sentences.zh: 我们的孩子承受着如此巨大的压力和紧张。

sentences.en: Even something that was, used to be fun, like playing a sport or playing a musical instrument, even that now is pursued with grim determination as a means to an end.
sentences.zh: 即使是曾经很有趣的事情，比如参加体育运动或演奏乐器，现在也带着冷酷的决心被当作达到目的的手段来追求。

sentences.en: So they're very heavily scrutinized by an audience that is the entire school of parents or the entire community, local community.
sentences.zh: 所以他们受到了一个由全校家长或整个社区、当地社区组成的观众的严密审视。

sentences.en: So the pressure of all of this is just so astronomical.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些带来的压力简直是天文数字。

sentences.en: It is no wonder that our children are showing such high and increasing levels of depression, anxiety, and substance use.
sentences.zh: 难怪我们的孩子表现出如此高且不断增长的抑郁、焦虑和药物使用水平。

sentences.en: Let me add one more thing.
sentences.zh: 让我再补充一点。

sentences.en: There was an article that just was published, I think, yesterday or the day before in the Journal of Abnormal Psychology on trends of increasing depression over time.
sentences.zh: 我想昨天或前天《变态心理学杂志》刚发表了一篇文章，关于抑郁症随时间增长的趋势。

sentences.en: And while there have been increases in all social demographic groups,
sentences.zh: 虽然所有社会人口群体中都有所增加，

sentences.en: I understand that the steepest gains, the steepest rises, increases, have been among the highest income level youth.
sentences.zh: 但我了解到增长最快、上升最陡峭的群体是最高收入水平的青少年。

sentences.en: In other words, the teenagers from the most affluent families are the ones who showed the steepest rises in levels of depressive symptoms over time.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，来自最富裕家庭的青少年表现出了抑郁症状水平随时间增长最快的趋势。

sentences.en: So this is not something we're imagining.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是我们凭空想象的。

sentences.en: That is one set of findings.
sentences.zh: 这是一组研究结果。

sentences.en: Another one is a report issued by the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, where they listed the top four environments that sort of jeopardize adolescent well-being.
sentences.zh: 另一个是罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊基金会发布的一份报告，他们列出了危害青少年福祉的四大环境。

sentences.en: The first three are not surprising.
sentences.zh: 前三个并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: One is exposure to poverty.
sentences.zh: 一是接触贫困。

sentences.en: Second is trauma.
sentences.zh: 二是创伤。

sentences.en: Third is discrimination.
sentences.zh: 三是歧视。

sentences.en: And fourth is excessive pressures to achieve, usually seen in affluent, not always, but usually seen in affluent communities.
sentences.zh: 第四是过度的成就压力，通常出现在富裕社区，虽然不总是，但通常出现在富裕社区。

sentences.en: So this is not something that we are imagining.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是我们凭空想象的。

sentences.en: This is not a one-town phenomenon or an
sentences.zh: 这不是一个城镇的现象，也不是一个

sentences.en: East Coast phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 东海岸的现象。

sentences.en: This is, it generalizes to upper middle class, upwardly mobile, well-educated families all over the country.
sentences.zh: 这是普遍存在于全国各地的中上层、力争上游、受过良好教育的家庭中。

sentences.en: This is not just the uber-rich.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是超级富豪的问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what advice do you have for parents in this situation when they're faced with mounting pressures from all sides?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于处于这种情况、面临四面八方巨大压力的家长，你有什么建议？

sentences.en: So I have advice for parents, but even before we go there, I want to underscore one more time, let's stop parents blaming.
sentences.zh: 我有建议给家长，但在那之前，我想再次强调，让我们停止指责家长。

sentences.en: You know, the truth is those of us who've had the good fortune of
sentences.zh: 你知道，事实是，我们这些有幸

sentences.en: attending good colleges and universities, it's, it's not unnatural for parents to want the same for their children, right?
sentences.zh: 进入好大学和好学院的人，家长希望自己的孩子也一样，这并不是不自然的，对吧？

sentences.en: You, you, you agree with me?
sentences.zh: 你，你，你同意我吗？

sentences.en: Oh yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，绝对同意。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, uh, what advice do I have for parents?
sentences.zh: 那么，呃，我给家长什么建议呢？

sentences.en: My advice is by all means, strive for the best, aim for the best you can for your children, help them pursue whatever activities and academic
sentences.zh: 我的建议是，无论如何，要争取最好，为你的孩子设定你能做到的最高目标，帮助他们追求任何他们想要的活动和学术

sentences.en: activities, extracurriculars that they want to, but be watchful for when they are getting too stressed,
sentences.zh: 活动、课外活动，但要留意他们何时变得压力过大、

sentences.en: too anxious, burned out and unhappy.
sentences.zh: 过于焦虑、精疲力竭和不快乐。

sentences.en: Be watchful.
sentences.zh: 要留意。

sentences.en: At that point, it is important for you to say, sweetheart, is it time to drop it down a notch?
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，对你说“亲爱的，是不是该放松一下了？”很重要。

sentences.en: Maybe there's something we need to pull back from, uh, watch out for your child's safety, obviously.
sentences.zh: 也许有些事情我们需要退后一步，呃，显然要留意孩子的安全。

sentences.en: Uh, so I know this is a hard thing to do because as the parents do want their kids to get ahead, but in this day and age, it's absolutely critical that we watch out for this.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以我知道这很难做到，因为家长确实希望孩子出人头地，但在当今时代，留意这一点绝对至关重要。

sentences.en: Stop with, do more.
sentences.zh: 停止“做得更多”。

sentences.en: Stop with this.
sentences.zh: 停止这样做。

sentences.en: You can, therefore you muSt. Stop with this.
sentences.zh: 你“可以”，所以你“必须”。停止这样做。

sentences.en: Just try harder.
sentences.zh: 只是尝试更努力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I do want to focus a little bit on, on what I was talking about on the, the situation that, that came to light this week, um,
sentences.zh: 我确实想稍微关注一下，我刚才谈到的，本周曝光的情况，嗯，

sentences.en: that, which does focus on parents and coaches.
sentences.zh: 这确实集中在家长和教练身上。

sentences.en: Um, do you think the parents in the alleged scheme deprive their children of the chance to make important decisions for themselves?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你认为涉嫌此事的家长剥夺了孩子为自己做出重要决定的机会吗？

sentences.en: Going back to that first question I had about, um, developing identity and autonomy.
sentences.zh: 回到我最初关于培养认同感和自主性的问题。

sentences.en: I think what the parents did was over the top.
sentences.zh: 我认为家长们的做法太过分了。

sentences.en: Obviously it's illegal and it's corrupt.
sentences.zh: 显然这是非法的，是腐败的。

sentences.en: Uh, having said that again, uh, I raised my own kids in Westchester
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我自己在纽约州威彻斯特县抚养我的孩子，

sentences.en: County, New York.
sentences.zh: 县。

sentences.en: They went through the same kind of pressure to achieve and accomplish.
sentences.zh: 他们经历了同样的成就和成功的压力。

sentences.en: And truthfully, all of us parents do whatever we can to help our kids.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我们所有家长都会尽我们所能去帮助我们的孩子。

sentences.en: Does that mean we're taking away a sense of control from them?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着我们剥夺了他们的掌控感？

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: As I said, a lot of this becomes self-propelled.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，很多时候这变成了自我驱动。

sentences.en: They do the extra
sentences.zh: 他们参加额外的

sentences.en: AP course and the extra sport and so on, because somehow in their minds that one extra, whatever it
sentences.zh: AP课程和额外的体育运动等等，因为在他们的脑海里，某种程度上，那多出来的一点，无论

sentences.en: is, is going to make the highest difference between acceptance or rejection, uh, from a, from a college of their choice.
sentences.zh: 是什么，都将成为他们被心仪大学录取或拒绝之间的最大差异。

sentences.en: So I'm not sure that parents are necessarily robbing their kids, uh, of a sense of control, uh, in this particular situation, any more than all of us do.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不确定家长们是否真的在这种情况中剥夺了孩子的掌控感，这并不比我们所有人做的更多。

sentences.en: Am I, do you understand?
sentences.zh: 我，你明白吗？

sentences.en: Do you see what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对明白。

sentences.en: Um, but I also want to understand like why, so why would failure be important for children and teens?
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我还想了解为什么，为什么失败对儿童和青少年很重要？

sentences.en: I mean, we're facing these mounting pressures that he said, even things that were fun, like a sport or music becomes a chore because it's related to accolades and
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们正面临这些不断增加的压力，正如你所说，即使是曾经有趣的事情，比如体育或音乐，也变成了苦差事，因为它与荣誉和

sentences.en: achievement and, you know, being the best, going to state championships, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 成就，你知道，成为最好的，参加州锦标赛，这类事情有关。

sentences.en: But, um, as a psychologist, why do you think it's, why do you think it's important for teens and children to experience failure at some level in their lives?
sentences.zh: 但是，作为一名心理学家，你为什么认为青少年和儿童在生活中经历某种程度的失败很重要？

sentences.en: I think it's important for teens and children to experience failure, just like it is for us.
sentences.zh: 我认为青少年和儿童经历失败很重要，就像对我们一样。

sentences.en: That said, once again, it's not clear to me that they don't.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，再一次，我不确定他们没有经历失败。

sentences.en: It's really not clear to me that they don't.
sentences.zh: 我真的不确定他们没有经历。

sentences.en: As I said, I've seen this generation of kids as being humongous, terribly overworked.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我看到这一代孩子被极其沉重地压榨了。

sentences.en: And if they are striving to be on that lacrosse team and a starter on the field hockey team and the number of things they set themselves up to do, and these are high
sentences.zh: 如果他们努力想进入那个长曲棍球队，成为曲棍球队的首发队员，以及他们为自己设定的各种事情，而这些都是高

sentences.en: level things, they do experience failures.
sentences.zh: 水平的事情，他们确实会经历失败。

sentences.en: They have to.
sentences.zh: 他们必须经历。

sentences.en: And what do you think this situation shows us about, um, meritocracy?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种情况向我们展示了关于“精英管理”的什么？

sentences.en: Do you think there is a meritocracy out there or is there a lack of it where you, you are, you achieve based on what you're on your skills and abilities, as opposed to
sentences.zh: 你认为存在精英管理，还是缺乏这种机制，即你基于技能和能力取得成就，而不是

sentences.en: perhaps having access to more resources and that sort of thing?
sentences.zh: 可能拥有更多资源等等？

sentences.en: There's no question that having access to more resources tips the balance in your favor.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，拥有更多资源会使天平向你倾斜。

sentences.en: Um, just even the system of legacies, uh, was just one example of, uh, how, how things, uh, legacies and, uh, and athletics.
sentences.zh: 嗯，仅仅是“校友子女优先”制度，就是一个关于事物如何，校友子女和体育运动的例子。

sentences.en: It's, uh, uh, flummoxes one to think that, uh, you know, just because you play a sport, uh, your chances of getting to a top-notch school are better.
sentences.zh: 这，呃，让人感到困惑，你知道，仅仅因为你参加一项运动，你进入顶尖学校的机会就更大了。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Because you're a champion chess player or a beautiful violiniSt. Uh, there, there, there are,
sentences.zh: 因为你是国际象棋冠军或优秀的提琴手。呃，那里，那里有，

sentences.en: there are some inequities and some things that just don't make very good sense in terms of how admissions are structured and not entirely fair.
sentences.zh: 那里有一些不平等，有些事情在招生结构方面确实说不通，而且并不完全公平。

sentences.en: So this, do you think this shows that education does not necessarily resolve societies and equities because there's always people coming at different levels?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为这是否表明教育并不一定能解决社会不平等，因为总有人处于不同的水平？

sentences.en: I mean, you study, um, teens and adults, I'm sorry, children and teens and poverty and also teens and children who are from affluent families.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你研究贫困的青少年和成年人，抱歉，贫困的儿童和青少年，以及来自富裕家庭的青少年和儿童。

sentences.en: I think the inequities in our society currently do play into this.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们社会目前的不平等确实在其中起作用。

sentences.en: Uh, uh,
sentences.zh: 呃，呃，

sentences.en: I think what our young people are feeling now is that if I don't make the same level of money, uh, that my parents do, uh, then I'm somehow going to be left behind.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的年轻人现在感觉到，如果我赚不到和我父母一样多的钱，那么我就会被抛在后面。

sentences.en: So young people are aspiring to have the same education experiences, uh, careers and standard of living that their parents, uh, did do.
sentences.zh: 所以年轻人渴望拥有和他们父母一样的教育经历、职业和生活水平。

sentences.en: And the truth is that it is in fact, much more difficult to do that in today's day and age, uh, uh, economics, globalization, and so on.
sentences.zh: 事实是，在当今时代，经济、全球化等等，要做到这一点实际上要困难得多。

sentences.en: So what's happening is that the, the, these young people are feeling like, unless I get into that school, unless I, which is
sentences.zh: 所以发生的事情是，这些年轻人觉得，除非我进入那所学校，除非我，这是

sentences.en: essential, if I'm going to get into a high paying job, my life is over.
sentences.zh: 必不可少的，如果我要找到一份高薪工作，否则我的人生就完了。

sentences.en: And someone asked me the other day.
sentences.zh: 有人前几天问我。

sentences.en: So why do they feel that?

sentences.en: And the message is also that sometimes universities put, put out tacitly or otherwise that you come here and you're on the path to something really grand, uh, once you graduate.

sentences.en: And of course, adolescence is a time when they want to brush, brush you off and they do that developmentally appropriate, but don't give up.

sentences.en: And that is something that is so threatened, so falling by the wayside for so many of our adolescents today, partly because they have no time.

sentences.en: They're rushing from pillar to post in a frenzied fashion, partly because of social media, where comparisons are constant, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们疯狂地从一个地方奔波到另一个地方，部分原因是社交媒体，在那里人们不断地进行比较，你知道，

sentences.en: FOMO people's, other people's lives are, are, are better than mine.

sentences.en: If you think about it, adolescents, you know, we, we used to bond across, uh, over activities that we shared.

sentences.en: Now you've got these two kids on the lacrosse team who are both being looked at from the scout that's coming from X or Y university.

sentences.en: They have, that they have to do what they can.

sentences.en: The truth is Caitlin, that it becomes a cultural norm.

sentences.en: And there are a couple of things that happen.

sentences.en: We all get caught up in this, you know, uh, in the sense of,

sentences.en: working.

sentences.en: And I said, no, I'm not adding one more thing to, uh, to the already very long liSt. What I'm saying is understand and prior, understand the need for you to be
